caption:
No Oil Chicken Shawarma Salad 
high protein | no oil/butter | easy meal prep 

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 35 | F: 10 | P: 40
Calories: 360 per serve
Makes 3 bowls of salad 

Ingredients
450 grams chicken breast, sliced into strips ( feel free to replace with paneer for a veg option and reduce quantity by half) 
marinade:
1 tbsp shawarma spices* see notes
1 tbsp minced garlic 
2 tbsp greek yogurt
juice of 1 lemon 
1 tsp black pepper
1/2 tsp sumac
salt, to taste

dressing 
4 tbsp greek yogurt
1 tbsp minced garlic 
large handful of chopped coriander
salt + pepper to taste
pinch of sumac
dash of lime juice

150 grams lettuce per bowl, use iceburg, romaine or any you prefer and whats available to you
1/2 pita per bowl of salad cut into 4 triangles, airfried for 5 minutes till golden brown and crisp 
1 onion sliced
1 cucumber, cubed small, i dont use the seeds
5 grams of feta, per salad, crumbled 

*if you dont have a ready shawarma spice at home, use the below mix
1 teaspoon red chilli powder + ½ teaspoon cardamom powder + ½ teaspoon cumin powder + ¼ teaspoon cinnamon powder + ⅛ teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes

Method
add the chicken to a bowl and add in all the ingredients for the marinade
place in the fridge for minimum 30 minutes upto 6 hours
cook on a non stick pan till its done 

for the dressing, combine all ingredients together and keep till you need to serve it
if making the dressing for meal prep and you will store it for later, dont add the lemon to it and keep it on the side to serve with 

to assemble, add the lettuce in a bowl, add in the chopped cucumbers, sliced onions and cooked chicken along with air fried pita and top with the dressing and some crumbled feta
